# RepoPress Plan Template

Use this folder to draft plans for complex tasks. Save work-in-progress plans here for review, but do NOT commit them to the repository without approval.

Filename convention:
- YYYYMMDD-brief-title.md (e.g., 20260326-add-auth-checks.md)

Template:

## Title

A short summary (1 sentence).

## Goals

- Goal 1
- Goal 2

## Scope

What is in-scope and out-of-scope.

## Approach

High-level steps to implement.

## Todos

- [ ] task 1
- [ ] task 2

## Risks & Notes

- Risk 1
- Important decisions or links to relevant files

## Reviewers

- @your-github-username

**Important:** Agents must not commit or push files in this folder. Save drafts here only; create PRs from feature branches that reference the finalized plan.
